how_to_apply: Read the detailed notification carefully and note the correct post code applicable to your qualification and specialization.
Register on the application portal and fill in personal, educational, and category-related details accurately.
Upload scanned copies of the photograph, signature, category certificate (if applicable), educational and experience certificates, mark sheets, and other documents as specified in the checklist.
Pay the applicable application fee of ₹1,180/- online (fee is waived for Women, SC/ST, and PwBD candidates).
Submit only one application; tick only the post for which you are eligible. Submitting multiple applications will result in rejection of candidature.
Review all entries carefully before final submission and keep the confirmation for future reference.
important_instructions: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Furnishing wrong, false, tampered, or incomplete information will lead to disqualification at any stage of the selection process, including after appointment. SC/ST category candidates applying against Unreserved (General) posts will be considered only under the general standard of merit, with no relaxation in the minimum qualifying percentage of marks. Where CGPA/OGPA/CPI or letter grades are awarded, candidates must upload an equivalence certificate from their University/Institute and produce the original at the document verification stage. No correspondence will be entertained regarding non-selection for interview or test/interview outcomes; candidates should regularly check the Institute website for updates. Any revision, clarification, addendum, or corrigendum related to this notification will be published only on the Institute website; no separate press notification will be issued. Requests for postponement or change of venue/location for the written test or interview will not be entertained under any circumstances. Selected candidates will undergo a medical examination and verification of character and antecedents; appointment will be offered only to candidates found fit. Misconduct such as using unfair means, impersonation, bringing electronic devices into the exam/interview venue, or canvassing will lead to disqualification and may result in debarment from future recruitment at FCRI or other Government of India organizations. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Palakkad Court only. In case of any ambiguity between the Hindi and English versions of the notification, the English version shall prevail.

Candidates holding a Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering degree can also explore more Engineering Government Jobs and Research Institute Jobs available across India. Applicants interested in similar research and scientific roles can check the latest Ministry of Heavy Industries Recruitment Notifications and Central Government Jobs 2026. Those looking for opportunities closer to Kerala can also browse Kerala Government Jobs and Palakkad Government Jobs matching their qualification.

content_sections.heading: FCRI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering with 5 years of relevant experience in the specific specialization applied for; OR M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering (with relevant specialization) and 3 years of relevant experience. Minimum 65% marks in the qualifying degree (60% for SC/ST category candidates applying against reserved posts). The Bachelor's/Master's degree must be a full-time regular course from a UGC-recognized Indian University, UGC-recognized Deemed University, or AICTE-approved course from an autonomous Indian institution. Desirable qualification for the Fluid Flow Research specialization: Ph.D. Detailed specialization-specific experience requirements (e.g., two-phase/multi-phase flow research, CFD in thermal and fluids engineering, design and testing of valves, fluid flow research) are given in the detailed notification at www.fcriindia.com. B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent in Mechanical, Civil, Electrical/Electrical & Electronics, or Instrumentation-related Engineering, as per the post code applied for. content_sections.text: Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and Transport Allowance are admissible on the Basic Pay at prevailing rates. content_sections.heading: FCRI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment must be made only through the online payment gateway on the application portal; no other mode of payment is accepted.

content_sections.heading: FCRI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is conducted in three stages: Screening of Applications: Applications are screened based on educational qualifications, experience criteria (where applicable), age, and payment of the application fee. Provisionally qualified candidates are notified via the Institute website. Written Test (Junior Research Engineer only): An online, bilingual (Hindi/English) Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) test is held at test centres in Coimbatore and/or Kochi (subject to availability based on the number of shortlisted candidates). Number of Questions: 100; Duration: 120 minutes Maximum Marks: 400 Marking Scheme: +4 for each correct answer, -1 for each incorrect answer, 0 for unattempted questions Research Engineer posts do not have a written test. Personal Interview: Provisionally shortlisted candidates are called for interview only after completing document verification, where all original documents (age, identity, qualification, marks, experience, reservation category, etc.) must be produced. Interviews are conducted at FCRI, Palakkad, Kerala, or another city approved by the competent authority. Final selection: For Junior Research Engineer, the final rank list is based on a weightage of 80% written test marks and 20% interview marks. For Research Engineer, selection is based on the Interview, though FCRI reserves the right to include additional assessment stages if needed. No TA/DA is payable for attending the test or interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for FCRI Research Engineer & Junior Research Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process closes on 24.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are there in FCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 19 vacancies in total - 4 for Research Engineer and 15 for Junior Research Engineer across Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, and Instrumentation disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. Can freshers apply for FCRI Junior Research Engineer post?
faq.answer: Yes, freshers may apply for the Junior Research Engineer post; no prior work experience is required. However, the Research Engineer post requires relevant post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam for FCRI Research Engineer post?
faq.answer: No, only Junior Research Engineer candidates need to appear for a written test. Research Engineer selection is based on a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for FCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹1,180/- per post for General, OBC, and EWS candidates. Women, SC/ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for FCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Research Engineer, the maximum age ranges from 35 to 40 years depending on category. For Junior Research Engineer, it ranges from 30 to 35 years depending on category, as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for FCRI Research Engineer and Junior Research Engineer?
faq.answer: Research Engineer carries Level 10 pay (₹56,100–₹1,77,500), with an approximate minimum gross pay of ₹1,01,130. Junior Research Engineer carries Level 8 pay (₹47,600–₹1,51,100), with an approximate minimum gross pay of ₹83,800.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for FCRI Junior Research Engineer?
faq.answer: Selection involves screening of applications, a written test, and a personal interview, with the final rank list based on 80% weightage to the written test and 20% weightage to the interview.
